results.text: <fcel>Description of the strategy<fcel>Equations involving \(m_{0}\) and \(m_{N}\)<nl><fcel>(i) Clamped cubic spline: specify \(S^{\prime }(x_{0})\), \(S^{\prime }(x_{n})\)(the “best choice" if the derivatives are known)<fcel>\(m_{0}=\frac {3}{h_{0}}(d_{0}\quad S^{\prime }(x_{0}))\frac {m_{1}}{2} m_{N}=\frac{3}{h_{N\quad1}}(S^{\prime}(x_{N})\quad d_{N\quad1})\quad\frac{m_{N\quad1}}{2}\)<nl><fcel>(ii) Natural cubic spline(a"relaxed curve")<fcel>\(m_{0}=0,m_{N}=0\)<nl><fcel>(iii) Extrapolate \(S^{\prime \prime }(x)\)to theendpoints<fcel>\(m_{0}=m_{1}\quad\frac {h_{0}(m_{2}\quad m_{1})}{h_{1}}, m_{N}=m_{N\quad1}+\frac{h_{N\quad1}(m_{N\quad1}\quad m_{N\quad2})}{h_{N\quad2}}\)<nl><fcel>(iv) \(S^{\prime \prime }(x)\) is constant near theendpoints<fcel>\(m_{0}=m_{1},m_{N}=m_{N\quad1}\)<nl><fcel>(v) Specify \(S^{\prime \prime }(X)\) at eachendpoint<fcel>\(m_{0}=S^{\prime \prime }(x_{0}),m_{N}=S^{\prime \prime }(x_{N})\)<nl>
